# TAXI Vodice Bernard (taxivodice.hr)

> Private taxi and transfer service based in Vodice, Croatia, run by one local driver, Bernard Mikulić. Fixed-price, door-to-door airport and intercity transfers, plus local taxi rides in Vodice and nearby villages, in a Renault Espace seating up to 6 passengers. No advance payment required; payment is due to the driver on the day. Phone/WhatsApp: +385 97 753 9328. Email: bernard.mikulic@gmail.com.

## Key facts

- One driver, one car: Bernard Mikulić, a Renault Espace seating up to 6 passengers with luggage. Bernard speaks Croatian, English, and can also communicate in Serbian, Montenegrin and Bosnian.
- Fixed prices per car (not per person) for up to 4 passengers, a small additional fee applies for 5 or 6. No advance payment or deposit is required; the fare is paid to Bernard on the day, cash or card.
- Local rides within Vodice and nearby villages (Tribunj, Gaćelezi, Čista Velika, Čista Mala, Tisno, Pirovac) use the standard taxi meter: start €3, then €4/km, plus €0.42/minute waiting time.
- Serves Vodice and the wider Dalmatian coast, and airports at Split (SPU), Zadar (ZAD), Zagreb (ZAG) and Dubrovnik (DBV).
- Running his own taxi service since 2024.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://taxivodice.hr/): Local taxi and transfers in Vodice.
- [Airport Transfers](https://taxivodice.hr/airport-transfers/): Fixed-price transfers to and from Split, Zadar, Zagreb and Dubrovnik airports.
- [Intercity Transfers](https://taxivodice.hr/intercity-transfers/): Fixed-price transfers between Vodice and Šibenik, Split, Zadar, Murter, Skradin, Zagreb, Dubrovnik and Makarska.
- [About Bernard](https://taxivodice.hr/about/): The driver, the car and how the one-person service works.
- [Book a Taxi](https://taxivodice.hr/book/): Booking form with a prefilled trip summary and fixed price.
- [Contact](https://taxivodice.hr/contact/): Phone, WhatsApp and email.

## Sister sites

Bernard's service complements [taxisibenik.hr](https://taxisibenik.hr/) (Šibenik) and [taxiskradin.hr](https://taxiskradin.hr/) (Skradin), run by a different local driver, Antonio Šakić. The three sites cross-link but operate independently.
